spans.s: गो-कंटक m.n. 1. a road or spot trodden down by oxen and so made difficult to pass; 2. the cow’s hoof; 3. the point of a cow’s hoof.

गो-कर्ण m. 1. a cow’s ear; 2. a mule; 3. a snake; 4. a span (from the tip of the thumb to that of the little finger); 5. name of a place of pilgrimage in the South, sacred to Śiva, श्रितगोकर्णनिकेतनमीश्वरम् R.viii.33.
गो-किराटा, किराटिका f. the sārika bird.
गो-किराटा, किराटिका f. the sārika bird.
गो-किल, -कील m. 1. a plough; 2. a pestle.
गो-किल, -कील m. 1. a plough; 2. a pestle.
गो-कुल n. 1. a herd of kine, वृष्टिव्याकुलगोकुलावनवशादुद्धृत्य गोवर्धनम् Git.G.iv.; 2. a cow-house; 3. name of a town (where Kṛṣṇa was brought up).
गो-कुलिक a. 1. one who does not help a cow in the mud; 2. squint-eyed.
